rationale: The answer abstained and showed the executed CAPEC query, but the expected Very High patterns under CAPEC-703 are CAPEC-177, CAPEC-555, CAPEC-57, CAPEC-94, and CAPEC-98. It only mentions CAPEC-98 as an example and does not state the other four, so it is partial rather than correct. The no-records claim is supported by the zero-row execution, but the query bound View.id to CAPEC-703 even though the gate noted View.id looks like capec:view:#, making the abstention less than fully reliable.
